description.narrative: USAID strengthens peace and reconciliation in Tanganyika province by mitigating conflicts, creating shared economic opportunities, and building social cohesion between Batwa and Baluba peoples. It supports intercommunity dialogues and women and youth groups in their efforts to promote peace.
